actions.action: Bind confirmation to the explicitly reviewed slot
actions.mechanism: Keep selected identity separate from refreshed availability; never substitute another slot when capacity changes.
actions.implementation: Store the slot ID and reviewed details. Send that ID to the existing atomic endpoint; require renewed review if booking details change.
actions.check: Invalidate or reorder slots between selection and confirmation. Verify no different booking occurs and endpoint rejection produces an explicit error.
actions.risk: Displayed availability remains provisional, not a reservation.

actions.action: Keep controls stationary through capacity refreshes
actions.mechanism: Update availability without removing focused elements, reordering choices, or moving confirmation away from the user.
actions.implementation: Use stable keyed controls and reserved status space. At 320 pixels, show vertically grouped days with keyboard-operable slots and a persistent confirmation area.
actions.check: Refresh every five seconds during keyboard and pointer traversal. Verify unchanged focus, stationary confirmation, no horizontal scrolling, and no obscured controls.
actions.risk: Persistent controls must clearly identify unavailable selections.

actions.action: Provide an untimed, preference-preserving recovery path
actions.mechanism: An unavailable slot opens a recoverable decision rather than resetting the booking or automatically choosing a replacement.
actions.implementation: Retain workshop, week, filters, and entered details. Explain the failure inline; offer matching alternatives for explicit selection and subsequent atomic confirmation, without countdowns.
actions.check: Force confirmation rejection, then pause across several refreshes. Verify retained preferences, keyboard-accessible alternatives, and no automatic booking or reset.
actions.risk: Alternatives may also become unavailable before confirmation.

actions.action: Measure recovery without scoring input speed
actions.mechanism: Evaluate correctness and retained intent under controlled invalidation, rather than rewarding faster confirmation or completion.
actions.implementation: Inject the same rejection at each participant’s first confirmation, regardless of elapsed time. Record wrong-slot bookings, preference loss, recovery completion, and abandonment.
actions.check: Repeat with keyboard-only use and a 320-pixel viewport, including motor-impaired participants. Report error counts and denominators; exclude completion speed from success scoring.
actions.risk: Scripted failures do not estimate real-world rejection frequency.
